answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded collateral escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate, attributable pairwise conflicts make the base penalty scale as O(k²), rather than as k independent fines. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier on capital loss makes a large swarm disproportionately costly; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovered stakes from restoring their former value. Like a plume revealing a pearl within a nebula, correlated evidence can expose identities that appear separate.
